The column now shows a 'Settings are locked while aligning — press Stop to change them.' note above the groups while a run is in flight, and the three settings groups dim to the muted opacity token. Kept above the disabled threshold so the operator can still READ the hemisphere/binning the run is using.

title: Re-opening Polar Alignment shows the previous run's "Alignment Complete" screen instead of a fresh start
summary: polarAlignmentStateProvider is app-scoped, so Done (which pops to Imaging) left the terminal state standing and re-entry landed on the old completion summary with Restart as the only way back to the instructions. The screen now releases a FINISHED run on dispose: only phase complete/error, via a post-frame callback (mutating a provider inside dispose lands mid-teardown), and a PolarAlignmentBusyException is swallowed so an in-flight history save is never forced. A run still in flight is untouched — coming back to a live measurement must show it. The controller and phase are snapshotted each build because `ref` is invalid inside a ConsumerState dispose.

title: Flat wizard Frame Count can only be changed one click at a time — 27 clicks to go from the default 30 to 3
summary: The read-only number between the -/+ steppers is now a real TextField: digits-only, 3-char limit, commits on submit and on focus loss, and normalises itself to whatever survives the notifier's 1..999 clamp so the field can never disagree with the run it will start. The steppers stay for gloved nudging and keep the field in sync; they now also carry tooltips and the + button disables at the ceiling.

title: Multi-Filter Batch and Sky Flats show bare unlabelled numbers under "Global Settings" (11% / +-10%)
summary: Added a _FieldLabel caption widget and used it on both tabs so Histogram Target, Tolerance and Frame Count are named exactly as they are on Quick Capture, instead of a bare '11%' stacked over a bare '±10%'.

title: The collaborative mosaic detail screen offers the mosaic's OWNER a "Join mosaic" button
summary: Added localMosaicProjectForHubProvider (mosaic_projects_dao.getByHubMosaicId, the same join key joinMosaicAsParticipant already uses) and branched the card on it: collab_role 'owner' now reads 'Your mosaic' / 'You published this mosaic...' / 'Open the local project'; an already-joined participant gets "You've joined this mosaic" / 'Open the local project'; only a mosaic with no local mirror still says 'Join mosaic'. The 'Joined X — claim open panels' snackbar is suppressed when the project was already linked, since joinMosaicAsParticipant returns the existing id without touching the hub. The provider is added to collaborativeMosaicStateProviders so publish/join invalidate it.

title: The Mosaic projects list has no way to create a mosaic and no back affordance
summary: Added a back bar (pop, falling back to /analytics where the entry point lives) to BOTH the populated list and the remote host-only state, mirroring the bar the mosaic project screen and the collaborative detail screen already carry. Added a 'New mosaic' action in the header that opens the same MosaicWizardDialog the sequencer toolbar uses; its 'Create mosaic project' action persists the design and routes to /mosaic/:id, so the loop closes on this screen. The empty state already named Framing/Planetarium as the design surfaces and was left alone.

title: Flat wizard tutorial GlobalKeys were attached to three simultaneously-mounted tabs (found while testing)
summary: Not in the findings list — my tab-switching test hit it. FlatWizardTutorialKeys.filterSelect/targetAdu/frameCount were passed by BOTH _BatchCaptureControls and _SkyFlatsControls, and startBtn by all three tabs. A TabBarView keeps the outgoing tab mounted across a switch, so changing tab threw 'The following GlobalKey was specified multiple times in the widget tree' in a debug build (and silently reparents state in release). Each shared key is now claimed only by the tab whose mode is selected.

title: All-Sky alignment shows a drift-derived error with no indication of how long the drift baseline is
summary: Split the finding. The measurable half is fixed: the All-Sky readout now carries 'Drift baseline: 4m 12s' under the az/alt/total tiles, computed from the exact interval the misalignment was derived over — state.initialError is the FIRST drift solve of the adjustment phase and state.currentError the latest, so their timestamp gap IS the baseline. It reads '0s' on the first sample, which is precisely the warning the audit's 0.0\" reading needed, and needs no native/wire change. WITHHOLDING the green 'Within acceptance' verdict below a minimum baseline is NOT done — see the needs-decision item below; picking that minimum is a product call. While fixing this I also closed a latent overflow: the All-Sky reticle is a Column that cannot shrink past its own caption, so unlike the TPPA bullseye it overflows rather than squashing when the flex path starves it; its layout floor now reserves a usable reticle slot.

title: Starting a co-imaging session makes you type RA and Dec by hand with no target lookup
summary: The sheet already prefilled from the framing target when one was set (the finding missed that), but inside the sheet there was no way to resolve a name and no way to take the mount's pointing. Added both, above the RA/Dec fields: 'Look up coordinates' resolves the typed name through targetCoordinateLookupProvider — the app's existing two-source resolver (target library, over the wire on a remote client, then the installed planetarium catalogs) — and applying a match fills the canonical name plus RA/Dec (converting the resolver's RA HOURS to this form's RA DEGREES); 'From mount' fills the centre from mountStateProvider and is disabled with a reason when no mount is connected or it has no coordinates. Both fields stay editable. Noted in the code: the resolver is declared inside the sequencer's Target-editor library and should move to a shared providers/ file — I did not move it because that file is being edited concurrently, and duplicating the two-source search here would be a second thing to keep in step with the catalogs.

title: The mosaic collaborative card never said how many panels THIS rig is holding
summary: Found while disproving the 'Claim all pending' finding below — it is the one true residual in it. The card reported '${panelsUploaded} of N panels uploaded to the hub', which is a different quantity from the one you need when deciding whether to claim more or hand some back. It now leads with 'You hold X of N panels · Y uploaded to the hub'; a local panel row only carries a claim token after this device's own successful claim, so the count is genuinely 'mine', not 'claimed by anyone'.

title: use_super_parameters lint in a collaborative_sky test added during this campaign
summary: Housekeeping, not a finding. A final `dart analyze` over the whole changed surface returned 3 infos; two are in unmodified files (the @Tags-before-imports pattern in the two captures_landscape_test.dart golden files, pre-existing), but collab_mosaic_publish_refresh_test.dart is new in this campaign and carried a use_super_parameters info on _FakeHub's mastersDao. Converted it to `required super.mastersDao` and dropped the now-redundant forward in the super() call.
